**Needs changes before merge.** One UI pin of this PR fails on the trial merge with the current `upstream/main`.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the gouge and collision guard of 3D Finish and Trace.

## What looks good

- `finish_centre_area` (`crates/app/src/operation/avoid.rs`) projects the full-tool keep-out from the cut bottom to the clearance plane. It subtracts the keep-out from the cutter-centre area and uses the existing `finish_clip::clip_path`.
- The inverse WCS yaw is correct. `WcsYaw::enter` rotates by `-yaw_rad` about the same origin. Thus `exit_region` with a negated yaw is the same map as the entry.
- The tilted (3+2) frame is consistent: `resolve` puts the protected items in the tilted-job frame, and the final guard reads that same frame.
- The final guard (`protect_path`) runs after the WCS restore and after fixture routing. It routes upright links and refuses a remaining contact by name. The post gate (`live_avoid_problems`) shares the same `clearance_problems` function.
- Without protected items, the moves stay the same. A pin asserts this.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the new production code. The command, undo and redo use the existing `SetOperationDoNotTouch`. The MCP description and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` agree.
- `avoid.rs` is 362 lines. The decision records are present.
- No recorded program changed (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`). This agrees with "Goldens moved: None".

## Results (local, trial merge of head `64d0b68` with `upstream/main` `835556814`)

- Quick gate plan: 171 steps. All app steps ran. Each app suite passed: 164 binaries, `do_not_touch` 5/5, `do_not_touch_finish3d` 5/5.
- `example_catalog`: 37 passed, 4 ignored (heavy lane).
- UI integration suites (`boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`): all passed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib`: **1 failed**, 1,444 passed or ignored. The failure is deterministic: it fails again when it runs alone.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: `example_catalog` (operations changed). No `testdata/` or importer change, so no kernel suite was owed.

```
---- egui_app::tests::do_not_touch_click::trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click stdout ----
panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs:82:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: the group is armed
  left: None
 right: Some(DoNotTouch)
```

## Mutations (run again by the reviewer; the tree was restored after each)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `finish_centre_area` returns the clip without the keep-out | red: 3 pins fail; the final guard refuses "violates 'Do not touch' tower face ... (Holder ...)" |
| No WCS yaw for the keep-out (`None`) | red: `finish3d_rotated_wcs_keeps_the_protected_face_in_setup_coordinates` |
| Final guard without link routing (`upright = false`) | red: `finish3d_lifts_links_above_a_protected_face_higher_than_clearance` (Shank refusal) |
| No final guard at all (`take_if(\|_\| false)`) | red: the 2 Trace pins in `do_not_touch`. The 5 Finish3D pins stay green |

## Requested before merge

1. **Red UI pin on the trial merge** - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs:82`. `trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click` does not arm the "Do not touch" group after the merge with the current main. The probable cause is #3324 on main (`start_exit_rows::not_taken_groups`, called from `op_page.rs`). It adds "Not taken" Start point and Exit point groups on the Geometry tab of Trace. These groups move the "Pick protected" button below the 1,100 px harness. Merge `upstream/main` into the branch. Then make the Trace fixture show the button (for example, the 1,400 px height that Finish3D uses). Run `camcraft-ui --lib` again.
2. **Heavy lanes** - the body says that the heavy lanes were not exercised. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches 208 app heavy steps for this diff. Run them on the final head against the current main and name them in the body. Alternatively, write "not run - owed to the wave run before merge" (AGENTS.md "Owed heavy result", #3467) and name the lanes.
3. **Screenshots** - the 3D Finish and Trace pages now show the "Pick protected" group. Add before and after screenshots of the Boundary group to the body. Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

## Notes (not blocking)

- With the final guard removed, the 5 Finish3D pins stay green: the clip alone keeps those fixtures clear. The guard does fire on Finish3D in the first and third mutations. A future pin can show the guard refusing a Finish3D path that the clip lets through (for example, a move that fixture routing changes).
- The PR is stacked on #3462 (draft, not reviewed). This review read and tested the full diff against main, which includes the Trace guard of #3462. Merge #3462 first, or merge this PR with #3462 as one wave.
- `gh pr view` reports `MERGEABLE`. `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` merged automatically.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the three requests of the review of `64d0b68`. The new head is `f7ff1d0802873b6b8f4601e672d1f023e6771947`.

1. **Red UI pin on the trial merge.** The branch now contains `upstream/main` `054c1e24b`. The merge commit had no conflict. The Trace fixture in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_click.rs` now uses the 1,400 px height of Finish3D.
   - Pin: `trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click`.
   - Proof: on the merged tree at 1,100 px, the pin fails at line 82 ("the group is armed"). At 1,400 px, all 8 `do_not_touch` UI tests pass.
   - `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 171 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes `ui suites: lib`.
2. **Heavy lanes.** `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `f7ff1d080`: 208 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Two known-fail entries were red as expected (#1950, #2849). The PR body has a "Heavy lanes" section.
3. **Screenshots.** The PR body shows the Boundary group of Trace and 3D Finish, before and after. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at commit `14b2955c7`.

Other results on `f7ff1d080`:

- Clippy on `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui` (`--all-targets -D warnings`) is clean.
- `example_catalog`: 37 passed, 4 ignored. The heavy `example_catalog` lane also passed.
- No recorded program changed.

Note: `upstream/main` is now `6e641dac7`. The new commits change only process and CI files, and `git merge-tree` with them is clean.

Please do a re-review of `f7ff1d080`.

**Needs a refresh before merge.** The three requests of the earlier review are done. But the PR does not merge with the current `upstream/main` `60376ccbb`: #3413 (Face "Do not touch") changed the same lines.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. The PR changes the gouge and collision guard of 3D Finish and Trace.

## Earlier findings (review of `64d0b68`)

1. **Red UI pin on the trial merge** - fixed. Commit `f7ff1d080` gives the Trace fixture the 1,400 px height. On head `f7ff1d080` (which contains `upstream/main` `054c1e24b`), all 8 `do_not_touch` tests of `camcraft-ui --lib` pass. This includes `trace_takes_a_protected_face_and_edge_by_viewport_click`.
2. **Heavy lanes** - fixed. The body has a "Heavy lanes" section: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `f7ff1d080`, 208 steps, 0 failed. The two red steps are the known-fail entries #1950 and #2849. Note: the conflict refresh below is a DELTA refresh, so the new head needs a new heavy result (own run or a wave record).
3. **Screenshots** - fixed. The body shows the Boundary group of Trace and 3D Finish, before and after. The four PNGs are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `14b2955c7`.

The production code of the PR did not change since `64d0b68`. The only new PR commit is the UI fixture height. No recorded program changed (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`, snapshot PNGs).

## Conflict with `upstream/main` `60376ccbb`

`git merge upstream/main` stops with conflicts in 4 files. The cause is #3413 (merge `a181bf1f3`, commit `b38f0c12f`), which added Face to the same allow-list. The PR body expected this overlap.

- `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:53` - `do_not_touch_applies`. Main has `Offset2D | Pocket3D | Face`. The PR has `Offset2D | Pocket3D | Trace | Finish3D`. Keep all five kinds.
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:63` - the text of `do_not_touch_unsupported`. Name all five kinds.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` - the `set_operation_do_not_touch` description. Name all five kinds.
- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34` - the same row. It must agree with `tools.rs`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:181-217` - keep the two tests `finish3d_shows_pick_protected_button` and `face_op_shows_pick_protected_button`. Make the assertion in `unsupported_op_shows_do_not_touch_note_without_pick_button` agree with the new text. Main's Face test asserts that the text "only so far" is absent; check that the new text keeps this true.

## Results (local, head `f7ff1d080`, not merged with `60376ccbb`)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib do_not_touch`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch --test do_not_touch_finish3d`: 5 passed and 5 passed, 0 failed.
- The full quick gate, clippy and `example_catalog` did not run again for this review. The production code did not change since the earlier review, and those steps passed there. The body reports them green on `f7ff1d080`.
- Extra suites run: none owed. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer.

## Mutations (run again by the reviewer; the tree was restored after each)

| Mutation in `crates/app/src/operation/avoid.rs` `finish_centre_area` | Result |
|---|---|
| No inverse WCS yaw on the keep-out (`Some(_yaw) => keepout`) | red: `finish3d_rotated_wcs_keeps_the_protected_face_in_setup_coordinates` |
| Return the clip without the keep-out | red: 3 pins. The final guard refuses "violates 'Do not touch' tower face ... (Holder, 0.027 mm short of 1.00 mm clearance)" |

## Requested before merge

1. **Refresh the branch** - merge `upstream/main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push). Resolve the 4 files above so that Face, Trace, 2D Offset, 3D Pocket and 3D Finish all apply. Then run the `do_not_touch` app and UI suites, `camcraft-ui --lib`, clippy, and the heavy lanes on the new head. A hand-resolved conflict is a DELTA refresh and gets a delta review.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The parent #3462 is still open with `needs-rework`. This PR targets `main` and contains the Trace guard of #3462. Merge #3462 first, or merge the two PRs in one wave.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
